items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Then, I joined the band of Mac Merrimickles Band. See. I worked with them.

ctx.x: Been here. Long time. Another thing, I don't like to worry a lot about those old times. I like to hear about it.

I would make it to you. And then, uh, that's the band I played with in Birmingham. All right. I lived in Birmingham. I went down in Florida. I went home, you see. Then, I joined the band of Mac Merrimickles Band. See. I worked with them. See, well, most of all the fellas was in Florida, was out of Florida, except Mac. And also the trombone, he was out of Mobile with George, uh, George Morris. He was out of Mobile. Well, I worked with them. Long time. Just traveling around on the road, see. And then after I, uh,…
